''See also: [[King Zakareth VI Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Zakareth]] VI, also known as King Zakareth the Sixth{{!}}Zakareth the Sixth, is the ruler of both [[Cana]] and [[Damasca]]. Holding titles such as [[Lord]] of the Morning and Evening [[Star]], he has maintained his reign for at least twenty-four years. He is the father of the heiress [[Leah]] and serves as the [[Incarnation of Ragnarus]]. Physically, the king is a powerful warrior in his sixties with gray hair and a build suited for combat. He possesses heterochromia, featuring one bright blue eye and one glowing red [[stone]] from the [[Crimson Vault]] that replaced a lost eye. His royal attire consists of a black-and-gold spiked crown set with a large [[ruby]], and functional dark metal armor lined with gold and reinforced by rubies from [[Ornheim]]. In battle, he utilizes a spear—sometimes referred to as the [[Lightning Spear]]—and a large black shield. As a leader, [[Zakareth]] is characterized by an authoritative and commanding presence, often demanding absolute obedience from those who govern in his name. His rule is marked by significant conflict, including preparations for war and tensions involving the [[Incarnations]] and various territories. He is a central figure in several major crises, including accusations of murdering [[Kai]], corrupting [[Indirial]], and declaring war on [[the House]]. His actions have also been linked to the deaths of [[Travelers]] and the destabilization of his kingdom's succession.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The King possesses white hair and a beard, complemented by skin featuring red and gold shining patterns. His eyes are mismatched, consisting of one bright blue human eye and a glowing red [[stone]] from the [[Crimson Vault]] that blazes like a star. He is clad in black and gold armor and wears a peaked crown set with a large [[ruby]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As the [[Ragnarus Incarnation]], he wields the crimson [[Ragnarus blade]]. He also possesses a Vault containing a [[wand]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Siege of Cana}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|While standing upon the walls of [[Cana]], King [[Zakareth]] VI watched the [[destruction]] unfold and spoke of placing a muzzle back over his hound.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c21">''City of Light'', chapter 21</ref> [[Ornheim]] and [[Indirial]] were required to reach the King so that he could seal the Fangs within the Vault.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22">''City of Light'', chapter 22</ref> Although he was linked to a setup involving the [[Endross Incarnation]], his true intentions remained a mystery to the group.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25">''City of Light'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26">''City of Light'', chapter 26</ref> The [[Ragnarus Incarnation]] possessed skin marked with red and gold shining patterns and wielded the crimson [[Ragnarus blade]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27">''City of Light'', chapter 27</ref> During the final confrontation, [[Zakareth]] was surprised by [[Simon]] before [[Alin]] blasted him with [[Gold]] [[Light]] and killed him.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27" />}}
